title: ORIGINAL SONY PLAYSTATION WITH...
reason: Complete-looking original PS1 bundle with three controllers, two memory cards and a game; retro console demand is steady, though untested.
findings: Original grey Sony PlayStation (PS1) console with the lid closed and the SONY / PlayStation logo on the lid; three controllers (one official-looking Sony pad with analog sticks and two third-party pads); a Command & Conquer PlayStation game in a grey Platinum-style case; two memory cards (translucent green with a PlayStation logo, and translucent black); an AV lead and a power lead with an Australian two-pin plug. A grey disc-shaped accessory with a translucent blue plug and a red LED sits in front of the console; its short maker text is too small to read (it may be a memory card reader). The console model number (SCPH series) is not visible. This supports the title (console, controllers, extras), but the photo cannot show whether it powers up or reads discs, and the title says not tested.
condition: Console casing looks clean and an even grey with no obvious yellowing, cracks or missing parts in the photo; untested; the game case looks scuffed and possibly cracked at one edge; controller cords look intact.
rescore_note: Original grey PS1 with three controllers, two memory cards, a game and leads. Retro demand is steady but it is untested and the model is not visible, so the low end of the $80 to $200 band. General knowledge, no web check.
